privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption
title: First cross-project audit run
goal: The first run is recorded with evidence and the proposals are listed for the owner
acceptance: each of the five checks was run against every component backlog and DOMAINS.md, with the evidence link per finding; the 2026-11-26 findings (nerv:F-101-T05, fpvbuddy:F-005 waiting on nerv:F-101-T04) are confirmed fixed
audit freshness is listed per repository (nerv last full audit 2026-11-20; fpvbuddy, hobo and bricks only baseline audits; gauntlet-protocol only a reconcile audit)
proposals are numbered, name the owning repository and the exact record or step, and are recorded on this record for the owner to accept or reject
